messages.text:
I am at a loss on what to do next. I guess this will be my last shot at
trying to get your company to respond and then I will have to figure out
what steps I can take to resolve this issue. Here is the issue and timeline:

Oct 12, Ordered miner which plainly stated on your web site that it was in
stock Order Shop····

Oct 24, After hearing nothing from your company I went to the chat on your
site to request information on my order. I was told they would turn it over
to someone and I would receive an answer back on Monday.

Oct 28, After still hearing nothing from your company, I once again
contacted customer support and was told someone would get back to me right
away.

Nov 2, After still hearing nothing back from your company, I had a google
meeting scheduled with Mike T. about why I chose your company. I
figured I could maybe ask him about my order. He was a complete no show. I
waited and he never joined.

Nov 2, After the no show from Mike, I contacted customer support again.
This time I was told that I had paid for my miner but it never reached the
warehouse and that was why no one had contacted me ??????? I was then told
that Abel or Georges would jump into the chat shortley, or if I left the
chat they would email me. After 30 minutes of waiting, I logged off. I have
yet to receive an email.

Nov 3, I tried calling the phone number for Abel Solomon that was on my
original order. All I received was recording in French and then it hung up
on me.

I am at a loss on how a company could operate this way and am very
disappointed. I hope I will hear back soon from you on a possible
resolution and not another "We will back to you shortly".

Tim W.
